title_en: Expression-level concordance and implementation sensitivity of ligand–receptor priority rankings in mouse cerebral ischemia
title_zh: 小鼠脑缺血配体—受体推断的跨队列表达一致性与优先级排序实现敏感性
author: 朱四欢
abstract_zh: 配体—受体表达效应的跨队列一致性可与推断优先级变化的一致性不同。本研究分析两个小鼠脑缺血队列的11个动物文库，并加入每组3个生物学重复的单核队列，通过保留依赖结构的标签置换、聚合诊断、固定排名母集和DecontX敏感性分析区分差异来源。在相同187条原规则候选上，表达共可用性为150/187同向（80.2%，ρ=0.725），原生LIANA 1.10.0优先级为105/187（56.1%，ρ=0.228）。每个独特评分列仅排名一次后ρ升至0.519；该诊断逐值复现了2026年9月9日已合并的上游聚合修正。固定全局排名母集后ρ为0.645，同时零效应增多。动态门槛表达同向率79.9%高于联合标签零分布中位数50.0%（精确P=0.005，6项Holm P=0.030），条件验证P仍为0.10。DecontX使匹配集合的表达相关由0.725降至0.641。在全部17个文库共同的99条候选上，原两队列表达同向80/99，涉及第三队列的比较为53/99和58/99（ρ=0.551和0.576）。原生表达—优先级差距部分源于已知聚合实现，剩余一致性仍依赖排名背景和队列。本案例量化这些影响，支持分别审计表达效应、候选优先级和表达资格。
abstract_en: Cross-cohort agreement of ligand–receptor expression effects can differ from agreement of inferred priority changes. We assessed astrocyte–endothelial candidates in two mouse cerebral ischemia cohorts (11 animal libraries), with an additional single-nucleus cohort reporting three biological replicates per group. Dependence-preserving label permutations, controlled aggregation diagnostics, fixed ranking universes and DecontX sensitivity analyses separated sources of disagreement. On the same 187 primary-selection candidates, expression coavailability agreed for 150/187 (80.2%; Spearman ρ=0.725), compared with 105/187 for native LIANA 1.10.0 priorities (56.1%; ρ=0.228). Ranking each distinct score column once increased priority correlation to 0.519; this diagnostic exactly reproduced the upstream aggregation correction merged on 9 September 2026. Fixing the global ranking universe yielded ρ=0.645 with more zero effects. Dynamic-gate expression concordance was 79.9% versus a 50.0% joint label-null median (exact P=0.005; six-test Holm P=0.030), while conditional validation P remained 0.10. DecontX reduced matched expression correlation from 0.725 to 0.641. On 99 candidates available across all 17 libraries, original-cohort expression concordance was 80/99, whereas comparisons involving the third cohort yielded 53/99 and 58/99 (ρ=0.551 and 0.576). Thus, the native expression–priority gap partly reflects a known aggregation implementation, while residual agreement depends on ranking context and cohort. This case study quantifies those consequences and supports separately auditing expression effects, prioritization and candidate eligibility.
conclusion_zh: 原两队列的表达效应一致性高于原生LIANA 1.10.0优先级一致性。受控聚合检查复现了已知上游修正并解释部分差距，排名背景和环境RNA估计带来进一步敏感性。在相同99条候选上，原两队列表达同向80/99，涉及第三队列时为53/99或58/99。本案例支持分别审计表达效应、优先级效应和候选资格，明确软件版本及方向分母。更广泛的转移和功能解释仍需独立证据。
conclusion_en: The original two cohorts showed higher expression-effect concordance than native LIANA 1.10.0 priority agreement. Controlled aggregation checks reproduced a known upstream correction and explained part of this gap; ranking context and ambient-count estimates contributed further sensitivity. On the same 99 candidates, expression agreement was 80/99 between the original cohorts and 53/99 or 58/99 with the third cohort. This case supports auditing expression effects, priority effects and candidate eligibility separately, with explicit software versions and directional denominators. Broader transfer and functional interpretation require independent evidence.
